lord.speaker: Lord Aldric
lines: The Barrow King, slain. My grandfather sealed that tomb and prayed it would hold.
You have done what three generations could not. This town owes you its sleep.

lord.speaker: Lord Aldric
lines: The Warden is dust? Then the way below lies open.
Beneath the ossuary sleeps the Barrow King, who ruled this valley before there was a town. End him, and the dead will rest.

lord.speaker: Lord Aldric
lines: The crypt lies beneath the mausoleum, beyond the graveyard gate. Go carefully.

lord.speaker: Lord Aldric
lines: A knight, in my hall? Good. I have need of a sword.
Every night the dead walk in the graveyard, and every night more of them.

lordAsk.speaker: Lord Aldric
lines: Something stirs in the crypt beneath the mausoleum. Will you go down and put it to rest?

lordCrypt.speaker: Lord Aldric
lines: Our dead, and older dead below them. A warden was set to guard the deeper tombs. It no longer remembers whom it guards them from.

lordYes.speaker: Lord Aldric
lines: Then go with my thanks. Father Edmund in the chapel will bless your blade, if you ask.

lordNo.speaker: Lord Aldric
lines: Then do not tarry long. The nights grow longer.

priest.speaker: Father Edmund
lines: Peace, traveller. Even here, among the graves.

priestBless.speaker: Father Edmund
lines: May the light keep you, and your wounds close. Go.

priestDead.speaker: Father Edmund
lines: Since the Warden fell, the skeletons in the graveyard lie quieter. But not still. Not yet.

priestDead.speaker: Father Edmund
lines: They rise from the old graves first, the ones whose names have worn away. Something below calls them up.

priestBye.speaker: Father Edmund
lines: Walk in the light.

merchant.speaker: Old Tobias
lines: Steel, flasks, a shield worth hiding behind. Coin first, knight. The dead don't pay, and neither do the brave, mostly.

choices.label: Where do you get all this?

merchantWares.speaker: Old Tobias
lines: Have a look. Mind the edges.

merchantWhere.speaker: Old Tobias
lines: The wardens' blades I had from my father, who had them from the crypt before it was sealed. Don't ask him how. He's buried in it.

merchantBye.speaker: Old Tobias
lines: Come back richer.

candidates.speaker: Villager
lines: Don't go past the graveyard gate after dark. Or at all, if you've any sense.

candidates.speaker: Villager
lines: The well's water tastes of iron since the dead started walking.

candidates.speaker: Villager
lines: Lord Aldric's in the keep. He's been asking after anyone who can swing a sword.

candidates.speaker: Villager
lines: My pigs won't eat. They know something's wrong.

candidates.speaker: Villager
lines: Father Edmund keeps the chapel lit all night. Says the dead don't like it.

candidates.speaker: Villager
lines: They say you went down into the crypt and came back. Is it true?
